---
title: "Before the session"
---
The session is worked in the [browser lab](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd), a page of the course site on which R runs inside your browser, with the data already in place. There is nothing to install and nothing to register for, and two things to do before you arrive.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| [Case study](../../cases/housing/index.qmd) | The original study and its design, SCORE and the Multi100 project, the five reanalyses and the question that each of them answered, how their results were put on one scale, and the replication with new data. The session works on this case throughout and can give it only a few slides. | 45 minutes |
| [Browser lab](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd) | Open it once on the machine and the browser that you will use, wait until the first cell shows a "Run Code" button, and run the setup cell of Task 1. If it does not load, try another browser, and tell the facilitator before the session. | 10 minutes |

**By the start of the session** you have the browser lab loading on the machine that you will use, and you know what the claim is and how the five Multi100 analysts came to different conclusions about it.
